name: @jiemurat/hyper-second-brain
description: Agent skills that set up and look after a second brain: a vault of notes and documents (for example an Obsidian vault) that AI agents keep in order for you. Installs fourteen skills: hsb-init, hsb-doctor, hsb-update, hsb-place-an-item, hsb-projects, hsb-review, hsb-find, hsb-capture, hsb-distill, hsb-create, hsb-share, hsb-restart, hsb-re-organize and hsb-connect.
author: Jiemurat

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check-build && npm run validate && npm test
